deployments_detail.use: "Apple Intelligence" — on-device + private-cloud generative AI across iPhone/iPad/Mac (Siri, writing tools, image gen)

Foundation Models framework: a native Swift API giving third-party app developers direct, free, offline access to the on-device LLM at the core of Apple Intelligence (used by apps like Streaks, CARROT Weather, SmartGym, Stoic). [Apple Foundation Models (on-device)]

Xcode Coding Intelligence: on-device ML predictive code completion trained for Swift/Apple SDKs, plus integrated coding assistants that connect to third-party LLMs (Anthropic Claude and OpenAI ChatGPT) for code generation, docs and error fixing. [Apple on-device model; Anthropic Claude; OpenAI ChatGPT]
Use of generative AI to accelerate custom Apple silicon chip design, described by hardware SVP Johny Srouji as a way to compress chip design timelines (exploratory, not yet in production).

Apple Intelligence on-device foundation model powering system-wide Writing Tools (rewrite, proofread, summarize), Priority notifications, and Smart Reply across iOS/iPadOS/macOS, running on-device with Private Cloud Compute for larger requests. [Apple Foundation Models (on-device + Private Cloud Compute)]

ChatGPT integration built into Siri, Writing Tools (Compose) and Visual Intelligence, letting users tap OpenAI's model for open-ended requests, document/image reasoning and content generation without a separate account. [OpenAI ChatGPT (GPT-4o/GPT-5 class)]

Live Translation in Messages, FaceTime and Phone, plus real-time in-person translation via AirPods Pro 3, using Apple's on-device generative models across 9+ languages. [Apple Foundation Models (on-device)]

Visual Intelligence: on-screen and camera content analysis that identifies objects, summarizes/translates text, searches similar images across Google, and hands off questions to ChatGPT, via Camera Control and the Action button. [Apple Foundation Models; OpenAI ChatGPT; Google image search]

Generative image creation features Genmoji and Image Playground, letting users generate custom emoji and stylized images (with optional ChatGPT styles like Watercolor and Oil Painting) from text and photos. [Apple Foundation Models (on-device image model); OpenAI ChatGPT styles]

Workout Buddy on Apple Watch: a generative-AI coaching feature that analyzes a user's workout data and fitness history to deliver personalized spoken motivation using a generative voice built from Fitness+ trainer audio. [Apple Foundation Models (on-device)]

Multi-year deal to use Google's custom Gemini models (via Google Cloud) to power a rebuilt, more conversational Siri and next-gen Apple Intelligence foundation models; enhanced Siri slated to launch spring 2026. [Google Gemini (custom model on Google Cloud)]

App Store trust-and-safety: automated detection processes (alongside human App Review) that reject fraudulent app submissions, terminate fraudulent developer accounts, block risky transactions, and remove fake ratings/reviews.
deployments_detail.value: $2B fraudulent transactions blocked in 2024 ($9B over 5 yrs); 146,000 developer accounts terminated; 143M fake ratings/reviews removed; 1.9M app submissions rejected
